slides.h: Dropping an anime at episode 3 is a [[skill]].
slides.dek: The watch-everything habit is how 40-show backlogs are born. Here is the case for walking away sooner.

slides.label: The math
slides.h: Every mid episode costs you a [[great]] one.
body: More good shows air every season than you have free evenings in a year. Sunk cost keeps you inside the wrong one while the right one waits on your list.

slides.label: The rule
slides.h: Three episodes, then one honest question.
body: Would you rather be watching something else right now? If the answer is yes, go watch that instead. A dropped show will still exist if you ever miss it.

slides.h: Team [[finish everything]], or team drop it fast?
slides.body: Defend your side in the comments. Send this to the friend with 40 shows on hold.
